tr.hint.zh: 用语音识别为这一集生成带时间轴的字幕，之后请在工作台核对文字与时间。
tr.hint.en: Generate timed subtitles from this episode's audio; review the text and timing in the studio afterwards.

tr.unavailable.zh: 自动转写未开通——请联系 Pulsar。
tr.unavailable.en: Transcription is not set up — contact Pulsar.

tr.done.en: Transcribed {n} lines; the page is refreshing.
